title: Doozy Vape Co Infinity Mango Guava Ice Shortfill E-Liquid 100ml
description: Mango Guava Ice by Doozy Infinity is a tropical fruit blend with a bright, juicy character and a fresh, icy finish. Sweet Mango delivers a rich, nectar-like base, while Guava adds a fresher, tangier note that lifts the flavour with its mellow sweetness. A streak of cool Ice rounds it off, bringing some delightful refreshment to this perfect pairing of fresh fruit flavours. This high-VG e-liquid is blended at a 70VG/30PG ratio and is perfect for Sub-Ohm vaping with powerful DTL (direct-to-lung) kits and tanks. Each 120ml shortfill bottle contains 100ml of nicotine-free e-liquid, with space for two 10ml nic shots to customise your strength. Doozy Infinity Shortfills offer bold flavour and generous vapour production for vapers who favour richer, smoother blends.
